foundation.title: Quantitative Foundations
foundation.description: Deterministic financial mathematics, discounting, present value, and fundamental probability distributions.

credit-risk.title: Credit Risk
credit-risk.description: Measurement, provisioning, and portfolio modeling of obligor probability of default, loss severity, and exposure.

impairment.title: Credit Risk Impairment & Provisioning
impairment.description: IFRS 9 / CECL expected credit loss accounting, staging criteria, and ECL provisioning models.

regulatory-capital.title: Regulatory Capital & RWA
regulatory-capital.description: Basel capital requirements, risk-weighted assets calculations, Tier 1 ratios, and prudential capital floors.

treasury-alm.title: Treasury & ALM
treasury-alm.description: Asset liability management, interest rate risk in the banking book (IRRBB), and liquidity ratios (LCR, NSFR).

traded-products.title: Traded Products & Derivatives
traded-products.description: Financial derivatives pricing, interest rate swaps, credit default swaps, and trading book valuation.

counterparty-risk.title: Counterparty Credit Risk
counterparty-risk.description: Counterparty credit risk exposure, valuation adjustments (xVA), collateral management, and derivative settlement.

market-risk.title: Market Risk & VaR
market-risk.description: Statistical loss estimation across trading books under normal and extreme market stress scenarios (FRTB, VaR, ES).

operational-risk.title: Operational Risk
operational-risk.description: Capital quantification for inadequate internal processes, system failures, human error, and legal events.

model-risk.title: Model Risk & Validation
model-risk.description: Model risk management, SR 11-7 validation standards, backtesting, sensitivity analysis, and governance.

risk-data.title: Risk Data Governance
risk-data.description: BCBS 239 risk data aggregation principles, data lineage tracing, metadata governance, and quality management.

financial-crime.title: Financial Crime & AML
financial-crime.description: Anti-money laundering, know-your-customer (KYC) compliance, sanctions screening, and transaction monitoring.

india-lending.title: India Lending & Prudential Norms
india-lending.description: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) prudential framework, IRACP income recognition, asset classification, and provisioning.

business-analysis.title: Business Analysis
business-analysis.description: Banking functional requirements, target operating models, regulatory change analysis, and workflow specification.

technical.title: Technical Infrastructure
technical.description: Financial software engineering, database architectures, high-performance computing pipelines, and risk engines.

quantitative.title: Quantitative Analytics
quantitative.description: Statistical risk modeling, machine learning algorithms, time-series forecasting, and ETL data pipelines.

legal-framework.title: Legal Framework
legal-framework.description: Contractual enforceability of netting agreements, collateral arrangements, and jurisdictional bankruptcy laws.

regulatory.title: Regulatory Standards
regulatory.description: Basel III/IV international capital adequacy frameworks, liquidity coverage requirements, and prudential ratios.
